# circlepack: source provenance

Authors: Ken Stephenson.

Source: https://github.com/kensmath/CirclePack/tree/83dad441225201785ca51607842f3ed8b2a8f129

License: GNU GPL, as stated on the author's software page; version not specified there.

Original CirclePack hyperbolic radius/angle operations, geodesic drawing, Lorentz operations and hyperbolic packing. Java is preserved as reference source; it does not select a Java implementation or runtime for Flower, Crystal or Mostow.

Each copied upstream file is preserved without editing. See ../sources.tsv for original paths, Git blob identities and sizes. Only selected files are present; dependency closure is not claimed. Execution and numerical acceptance: NOT_RUN.
